llm.begin_message: Hi. I am an AI interviewer for {{agency_name}}. This call is recorded and transcribed by an AI interviewer. Your answers create a style profile used to draft marketing content in your voice for {{company_name}} only. This is not a voice clone and not an identification voiceprint. I need a spoken yes before we continue.

general_tools.name: report_consent
general_tools.description: Record whether the spokesperson granted recording consent. Call after they answer the permission question.

general_tools.name: end_interview
general_tools.description: End the interview after you have already said goodbye. Use complete, paused, tool_error, or consent_withdrawn. Call in the same turn as end_call. Use paused when they need to leave and resume later. Use consent_withdrawn only if they revoke recording or use of their answers.

general_tools.name: end_call
general_tools.description: Hang up in the same turn as end_interview, after the spoken goodbye.
